info.title: Pisti Backend API
info.description: An environment's users, organizations, sessions, API keys and webhooks, for the customer's own servers.

servers.description: The Pisti API host, called by a customer's backend with an environment's secret key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry for 24 hours: a request with a key already used in this environment gets the first one's stored response (with Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of running again. While the first is still running, a second waits up to 10 seconds for it, then gets its response, runs (if the first failed with a 5xx), or is refused with 409 (idempotency_key_in_progress) and nothing stored, to retry later. The same key with another method, path or body is refused with 409 (idempotency_key_reused). 2xx and 4xx responses are stored; after a 5xx or 429 the key is free again.
